scope: Only the two named scripts; static connected logic review and eight tiny synthetic checks.

resolved_findings.problem: Direct writes to final support could leave partial canonical evidence after interruption and prevent retry.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owner now writes support__staging and renames after manifest creation. Small actual-copy-loop check confirms final remains absent before promotion.

resolved_findings.problem: Copy-time hashes could accept bytes changed after frozen/artifact/review validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owner binds validated sources to expected freeze, review, artifact and snapshot hashes before copying. A tiny altered source is rejected before destination creation.

resolved_findings.problem: Public cohort paths are relative to manifest parent but audit resolved them against current working directory.
resolved_findings.resolution: Owner resolves relative run paths against manifest_path.parent, preserving absolute paths and containment. Actual AST path block passes a public-path fixture.

resolved_findings.problem: Native Windows artifact keys use backslashes, so the prior figures/ prefix predicate rejected valid complete analysis manifests.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root normalizes each key through Path(n).as_posix before checking the figure prefix. Actual completed cohort manifests each expose 14 existing PNG paths under the new guard; both failed the old guard. Two no-figure controls remain rejected. Original artifact manifests were read without rewriting.

tests: concentration-unit absolute error and dimensionless symmetric NMAE/bias
public relative path resolved from manifest parent
small_checks.test_method: Actual copy-loop and run-path AST blocks, helper imports without main(), and tiny local temporary files only.
small_checks.initial_test_harness_issue: First AST selector encountered a nested tuple; selector corrected before any tests executed. Subsequent eight checks all passed.

static_findings.containment: Lexical and resolved containment plus link-component rejection in packager; resolved run/input containment in independent audit.
static_findings.provenance: Manifest, freeze, study results, analysis artifacts and review bindings checked; portable path rewrites preserve original manifest copies.
static_findings.math: For uniform fixed grid/time weights, L is mean absolute concentration difference; symmetric NMAE and bias divide by mean of two means. A/B/D carry concentration units; R and V are dimensionless. Gate uses A<B for B>0 and exact A=0 for B=0; dispersion band inclusive 0.5..2.0.
static_findings.claim_boundary: Independent review remains pending human diagnostics and explicitly does not establish physical equivalence or RNG stream independence.

not_checked: Measured raw inputs, outputs and completed cohort artifacts were not loaded.
No model, GPU, build, timing measurement or full analysis was run.
Full package construction, recipient environment and end-to-end reproduction remain untested.
No changes to frozen source, validation or analysis scripts were made by this reviewer.

humanize.manual_fidelity_review: Numbers, equations, identifiers, path meaning, claim limits and nonexecution scope preserved.
humanize.style_candidate: UNIFORM_RHYTHM was manually reviewed and retained for distinct review scope and fix statements; no semantic warning remains.

narrow_rebind_history.reason: Owner added only independent_raw_review.json to qa_names.
narrow_rebind_history.reader_test_scope: Standalone SourceSeriesReader session-only status is separate from these two scripts.
